The N stage for Kidney Renal Papillary Cell Carcinoma is determined by the presence and extent of lymph node metastasis. According to the AJCC Cancer Staging Manual (7th edition), the N stage is assigned as follows: 
N0: No regional lymph node metastasis 
N1: Metastasis in a single regional lymph node 
N2: Metastasis in more than one regional lymph node 
N3: Metastasis in a contralateral or in para-aortic lymph node(s)
